en.title: Madonna di Campiglio powder forecast next week (23–29 November 2026): 27 cm up top
en.description: Madonna di Campiglio snow forecast for 23–29 November 2026: 27 cm at the top (8–46 cm), 23 cm at the base, snowiest day Wednesday 25 November, with neighbours compared.
en.lede: Madonna di Campiglio has fresh snow on the way for the week of 23–29 November. At the top, around 2500 m, our forecast adds up to 27 cm, with 8 cm in a low case and 46 cm in a high one; mid-mountain gets 25 cm and the base around 1600 m 23 cm.

sections.h: When and where to ski Madonna di Campiglio
p: Aim for the day after Wednesday 25 November. That day brings the biggest share at the top (13 cm, high case 19 cm), and the first clear morning after it gives the softest snow with some visibility.

Go high: depth is safest on the Grostè and the Spinale, and the best skiing should be on the broad high slopes of the Grostè under the Brenta Dolomites. Treat the town of Madonna di Campiglio as the weak point.

sections.h: How the week of 23–29 November adds up in Madonna di Campiglio
p: At the top (around 2500 m) the week totals 27 cm, 8–46 cm across our range. Mid-mountain around 2000 m gets 25 cm (8–43 cm), and the base around 1600 m 23 cm (5–41 cm).
The snow is not spread evenly. The days that matter at the top are Wednesday 25 (13 cm, up to 19), Thursday 26 (10 cm, up to 18) and Friday 27 (3 cm, up to 6); the rest of the week is close to dry.

sections.h: This week in Madonna di Campiglio: the set-up
p: This week gives little here: 6 cm at the top from 17 to 20 November and 3 cm at the base. Next week is the bigger of the two for Madonna di Campiglio, which is the reverse of the western Alps.
Little is lost on the way down: 23 cm around 1600 m against 27 cm up high. On these numbers the precipitation falls as snow almost everywhere in Madonna di Campiglio.
Campiglio is the western door to the Dolomites and catches more of the southern storms than the eastern valleys.

sections.h: Is Madonna di Campiglio the best bet nearby?
p: For comparison, the upper slopes of the closest big resorts collect Livigno (63 km away) 19 cm, Obergurgl (73 km away) 13 cm and Val Gardena (79 km away) 11 cm; Madonna di Campiglio sits at 27 cm.
Madonna di Campiglio comes out ahead of its neighbours this time, which is worth knowing if you are choosing between them.
Not very. The high case gives 46 cm up top, the low case just 8 cm, so whether Madonna di Campiglio gets a real fall depends on a storm track that is still undecided.
Storm timing tends to firm up first; totals keep moving until a day or two before.

advice: Before leaving the pistes in Madonna di Campiglio, check the regional avalanche bulletin (bollettino valanghe).
Early season: confirm which lifts are open with Madonna di Campiglio itself before you travel.
Watch the forecast midweek: the top's range is 8–46 cm.
